name: Property Experience System™
what_it_fixes: Home buyers deciding from flat, low-quality listings.
what_it_is: A way of showing property that answers the buyer's real question: what it would be like to be there. Film, stills and a listing built so certainty replaces guesswork.
what_you_get: A listing page built around the decision, not the specification
One visual standard across every property
Measurement of what buyers actually look at
who_it_is_for: Agencies and developers whose listings look like everyone else's.

name: Restaurant Memory System™
what_it_fixes: Hotels and restaurants that are hard to remember in a crowded market.
what_it_is: The parts of a hospitality brand people remember afterwards: how it looks, how it is photographed, what arrives at the table, and what is posted between visits.
what_you_get: Identity and the rules that hold it
A social pattern that survives a busy week
One look across the room, the plate and the feed
who_it_is_for: Hotels and restaurants that are good in person and forgettable online.

name: Authority Engine™
what_it_fixes: Money lost on plain ads that do not build trust or justify higher prices.
what_it_is: Turning proof into pricing power. Instead of ads that ask for trust, we publish the evidence that earns it, then put budget behind the pieces that move people.
what_you_get: Positioning and the argument behind the price
Proof assets: case studies, results, written work
Measurement tied to enquiries, not impressions
who_it_is_for: Premium businesses whose prices are questioned because nothing proves them.

name: Growth Clarity Framework™
what_it_fixes: Doing random marketing tasks without knowing the real problem.
what_it_is: The diagnosis. Eight pillars measured, one score out of a hundred, and a written map of where attention, trust and revenue are leaking, before anyone proposes a tactic.
what_you_get: The VIXART Growth Audit™ across eight pillars
A score out of one hundred with the working shown
A sequenced roadmap of what to fix, in order
who_it_is_for: Anyone about to spend money on marketing without knowing what is broken.

name: Business Transformation Sprint™
what_it_fixes: A gap between the big plan and the actual build.
what_it_is: Diagnose, design, build and launch under one timeline, with the whole team on one client. Roughly twelve weeks from the audit to a live system, then into ongoing growth.
what_you_get: Brand, platform and acquisition built in parallel
A coordinated launch, not a switch flip
A weekly report and a quarterly review
who_it_is_for: A business that needs the whole thing moved, not one piece improved.

name: Always-On Answer System™
what_it_fixes: Customers waiting on answers your team types out by hand, every day.
what_it_is: An assistant that answers your customers from your own material (your catalogue, your prices, your policies) on your website, on WhatsApp, or inside your app. It only answers from what you give it, so it does not invent things.
what_you_get: Trained on your own documents, catalogue and policies
Handover to a human when it should not answer
Scanned archives read and made searchable
Private or on-premise setup when the data is sensitive
who_it_is_for: Businesses answering the same questions all day, or losing enquiries that arrive after hours.

name: Back-Office Autopilot™
what_it_fixes: Staff retyping the same invoices, quotes and follow-ups instead of selling.
what_it_is: The repetitive paperwork handled by software. Invoices, contracts, purchase orders, IDs and receipts are read, turned into clean data, sorted and passed to the right person. Quotes, order intake and follow-ups are drafted for approval.
what_you_get: Invoice, contract, PO, ID and receipt reading
A person approves before anything is sent
who_it_is_for: Teams whose day is filled with retyping, and who lose deals to slow quotes.

name: Operations Backbone™
what_it_fixes: A business run on spreadsheets that no two people read the same way.
what_it_is: One place where sales, purchasing, stock, production, accounting, HR and till all live. We set up the ERP, build the parts your business does differently, and move you off spreadsheets with the data cleaned on the way in.
what_you_get: Odoo or a comparable ERP, set up and rolled out
Sales, purchase, inventory, manufacturing, accounting, HR, POS
Custom modules for what the standard product will not do
Migration from spreadsheets or an old system
Data cleaned and checked before it lands
Demand forecasting, smart reordering, and alerts on odd invoices or stock
who_it_is_for: A business big enough that no one person can hold the whole picture any more.

name: Revenue Pipeline System™
what_it_fixes: Leads going cold because nobody knows whose turn it is.
what_it_is: A CRM set up the way you actually sell. Every enquiry lands in one pipeline with an owner and a next step, and the follow-up happens whether or not anyone remembers.
what_you_get: Pipelines, stages, scoring, permissions and dashboards
Lead capture from your site and your ads
Lead scoring so the best enquiries surface first
Call and meeting summaries written automatically
who_it_is_for: Anyone whose leads arrive in several places and get followed up by memory.

name: Owned Platform System™
what_it_fixes: Renting your business on tools that were never built for it.
what_it_is: Software built for your business and owned by your business. A web app, a mobile app, a client portal or a shop, built to fit how you work, with no licence you cannot leave.
what_you_get: Web applications and SaaS platforms, multi-tenant and billing-ready
iOS and Android from one codebase
Client portals, admin panels and internal tools
who_it_is_for: Businesses paying monthly for tools that still do not do the one thing they need.

name: Single Source of Truth™
what_it_fixes: Every tool showing a different number for the same question.
what_it_is: Your systems joined up so they agree. ERP, CRM, shop, accounting, payments and delivery pass data to each other, and the reporting is built once, on top of all of it.
what_you_get: Integration between ERP, CRM, e-commerce, accounting, payment and logistics
Bridging to older systems that cannot be replaced yet
who_it_is_for: Anyone who has been in a meeting where two departments quoted different numbers.

name: Continuity System™
what_it_fixes: Software that quietly rots until the day it breaks.
what_it_is: Keeping what we built alive and safe. Hosting, deployment, monitoring, backups, security and cost control, plus the training and documentation your team needs to run it without us.
what_you_get: Support retainers, training and written documentation
who_it_is_for: Any business whose software is now load-bearing.

name: Brand Film System™
what_it_fixes: A business that has to be explained every time, instead of simply being seen.
what_it_is: One film that says what the business is, so it stops needing to be explained. Directed, shot and edited in-house, from the same visual rules as everything else you own.
what_you_get: Shooting, including drone where it helps
A long cut plus the short versions
Delivered in every format you actually post in
who_it_is_for: Businesses whose story only works when a person is there to tell it.

name: Location Story System™
what_it_fixes: A place that looks nothing like the feeling of standing inside it.
what_it_is: Filming a place so the footage feels like standing in it. Cinematography and drone work built around the route a guest or buyer actually takes.
what_you_get: A cut per space or per journey
Stills pulled from the same shoot
who_it_is_for: Hotels, restaurants, venues and property, where the place is the product.

name: Product Image System™
what_it_fixes: Products shot a different way every time, so nothing looks like one brand.
what_it_is: Photography turned into a rule rather than a booking. The lighting, angles, background and crops are decided once and written down, so every future shot matches the first.
what_you_get: Lighting and framing defined and documented
Crops for shop, social and print
A written guide so a re-shoot matches
who_it_is_for: Anyone whose catalogue looks like it was photographed by five different people.

name: Social Cut System™
what_it_fixes: Running out of things to post two weeks after the camera leaves.
what_it_is: One shoot cut into a run of short videos, so posting does not stop when the camera leaves. Cut from the same footage and the same look as the brand film.
what_you_get: A posting run planned in advance
Templates so your team can cut more
who_it_is_for: Teams who shoot once, post for two weeks, and then go quiet.

name: Launch Film System™
what_it_fixes: A launch that comes and goes without anyone noticing it happened.
what_it_is: The film and the images for a launch (a drop, an opening, a new product), built as an event with a date, rather than a post.
what_you_get: Stills for the launch page and ads
Performance watched live on the day
who_it_is_for: Brands whose launches pass without anyone noticing.

name: Brand Identity System™
what_it_fixes: A brand that looks like a different company on every surface it appears on.
what_it_is: The mark, the type, the colour and the rules that hold them together, so the brand looks like one company everywhere it appears.
what_you_get: Files in every format your suppliers need
who_it_is_for: Businesses whose logo means something different on every surface.

name: Packaging System™
what_it_fixes: A product that loses its argument the moment it sits on a shelf.
what_it_is: Packaging designed so the argument survives the shelf. Structure, artwork and print files, built as a system that stretches to the next product without a redesign.
what_you_get: A rule set for the next product in the range
who_it_is_for: Products that convince online and lose the argument in the hand.

name: Interface Design System™
what_it_fixes: Screens that look unfinished next to the brand that pays for them.
what_it_is: The visual layer of your screens: type, spacing, colour, states and detail, so the product looks like it belongs to the brand paying for it.
what_you_get: Files handed to the build team in a usable form
who_it_is_for: Products that work but look unfinished.

name: Print & Signage System™
what_it_fixes: Menus, cards and signs that look nothing like the brand online.
what_it_is: The physical surfaces: menus, cards, signage, packaging inserts, vehicle and window graphics, all designed from the same rules as the brand online.
what_you_get: A template set your team can reuse
who_it_is_for: Businesses whose printed material was made by whoever was free that week.

name: Campaign Art System™
what_it_fixes: A campaign that has to be redesigned from scratch for every channel.
what_it_is: A campaign designed once as a system, then sized to every channel, so nothing has to be redesigned from scratch for a new format.
what_you_get: A master layout and its variations
Editable files for the next round
who_it_is_for: Teams re-making the same campaign for every platform.

name: Product UX System™
what_it_fixes: A product built on guesses about what people actually want.
what_it_is: Deciding what the product should do, and proving it, before it is built. Research, flows and a clickable prototype tested with real people.
what_you_get: Testing with real users, and what changed because of it
who_it_is_for: Anyone about to build a product from an opinion.

name: Usability Repair System™
what_it_fixes: A product people use, then quietly give up on.
what_it_is: Finding why an existing product loses people, and fixing it. We watch real sessions, measure where users drop out, and repair the worst points in order.
what_you_get: Usability audit of the live product
Every drop-off point ranked by cost
who_it_is_for: Products with traffic and complaints, but no clear reason why.

name: Component Library System™
what_it_fixes: Every new page rebuilt from scratch, and slightly different each time.
what_it_is: A reusable kit of the product's parts (buttons, forms, tables, layouts), so a new page is assembled rather than redrawn, and stays consistent as the team grows.
what_you_get: An audit of what already exists
A component set, designed and documented
Rules for spacing, type and colour as tokens
Built in code, ready to use
Documentation so new people follow it
who_it_is_for: Teams where every new screen is slightly different from the last.
